args.question: The standard 16x12x10 box (BX-161210-32, 32 ECT) is out of stock, with 120 more arriving at our North warehouse on Friday, November 6, which is after Thursday. Would you like a substitute? Options: (a) 16x12x10 32 ECT recycled kraft (BX-161210-32E), 105 bundles in stock at $27.90 per bundle of 20 at list price; (b) 16x12x10 44 ECT standard (BX-161210-44), 457 bundles in stock at $35.40 per bundle, a heavier-duty box; or (c) wait for the standard box on November 6. Once you choose, we will order 50 bundles to Building 2 for delivery by Thursday, if it can make that date.

finish.reply:
Hello Dana,

Thank you for your email. The standard 16x12x10 box (32 ECT) is out of stock. Our next delivery of that box is due at our North warehouse on Friday, November 6, which is after Thursday.

We have two substitutes in stock:
- 16x12x10, 32 ECT, recycled kraft (SKU BX-161210-32E): 105 bundles of 20 available, $27.90 per bundle at list price.
- 16x12x10, 44 ECT, standard (SKU BX-161210-44): 457 bundles of 20 available, $35.40 per bundle. This is a heavier-duty box.

Which would you like? Or would you prefer to wait for the standard box on November 6? Once you choose, we will order 50 bundles to Building 2 and confirm the delivery date with you. We have not placed the order yet.

The Wendlow order desk
